offers_products.reason: Main offering is testing services; consumer test panels are minor relative to lab services.

offers_services.reason: Clinical lab testing, drug development and research testing services for patients, providers and biopharma.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients and consumers order tests directly and use the MyLabcorp app; patients receive the testing.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Works with health systems, providers, payers, hospitals and biopharma companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Routine diagnostic testing is repeat volume from providers, health systems and payers, plus ongoing biopharma contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Medical diagnostic testing is needed for patient care and is hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Individual lab tests are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Delivery depends on lab network, testing technology and scale rather than mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are health systems, payers, hospitals and large biopharma companies, though patients are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs a global network of laboratories, patient service centers and logistics needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Larger part is Diagnostics (lab testing); Drug Development serves biopharma.
